scope: Descriptive B5000 accessibility; no continuation gate and no equivalence claim.
features: FP32 frozen student PoseHead LayerNorm on cached fp16 latents; float64 ridge sufficient statistics; no feature scaling

alpha_selection.objective: pooled masked standardized SSE / valid elements across both held-out folds; raw-SSE ridge penalty

reference_head_check.checked: all per-user moment sums and support counts

head.scope: Descriptive decomposition of fixed B5000 student predictions; no pass/fail criterion, fit or new prediction.
head.units: standardized squared angles for decomposition; radians for E1 MAE control
head.aggregation: Compute population moments per window/joint; pool with valid-element weights. Centered statistics and every component of their decomposition use only n>=2 window/joint cells.
head.gain_identity: On the identical n>=2 support: total_gain=(E[y^2]-MSE)=gain_mean+gain_centered; gain_mean=mean(y)^2-(mean(p)-mean(y))^2; gain_centered=var(y)-centered_MSE.
head.interpretation: Mean and centered gains are additive error components, not causal mechanisms. Components can be negative; no percentage attribution is imposed. Pooled-centered correlation removes each window/joint mean and contains no between-window covariance.

bootstrap_centered.estimand: ratio of pooled centered MSE to pooled target temporal variance; gain = pooled vary minus centered MSE
